text_original: Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Driver Power 2026 owners rank the Model 3 first of 50 cars for powertrain, as reported by Auto Express. Driver Power 2026 owners rank the Model 3 first overall and first for quality and reliability, as reported by Auto Express. Driver Power 2026 owners rank the Model 3 second of 50 cars for infotainment, as reported by Auto Express. Auto Express reports that Driver Power owners criticise the lack of physical buttons. Auto Express reports that Driver Power owners criticise build quality in places.
